textSegments: Complies with ATX 12V v2.4 & EPS 12V v2.92

HYPER S series comes ranging from 500W, 600W to 700W for your choice. Enthusiasts of Gamer and hardware, you won't miss HYPER series this time, the high stable performance but affordable price will be your BEST choice.

HYPER S series comes with the +12 single rail design and the SATA array cable, optimized the airflow in case, no-hassle with case side panel. Also, 120mm long lasting fan provides superior cooling, noise <19dBA at 50% loading. Multiple PCI-Express 6+2 pin connectors equipped also 8 units of SATA cable provided.
50mm intervals for 4 SATA device installation to optimized the airflow in case and no-hassle with case side panel.
The total AC power consumption of the completed system is less than 0.5W in standby mode.
